entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello? I... I think I need to return something. I'm a bit lost on how to do it.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Michael Chen. The order number is... VF789012. The website was a bit confusing, I thought I was buying the right thing.

I understand, Michael. I've located your order for the VeloPro cycling shoes. I see they were delivered four days ago. To make sure I'm assisting you correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference with the fit?

I... I don't know, really. I think a preference? I installed the cleats and went for a single ride, but they felt awful. I got terrible blisters on my heels. I'm just so overwhelmed. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help. I'm very sorry to hear they caused you blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want. It sounds like a sizing or fit issue, which can be tricky to get right online.
So... can I send them back? I was worried since I wore them once. I just want a refund if possible.

Absolutely. For items like our cycling shoes, we have a 90-day return policy, even if they've been lightly used for a test ride. Since you're only on day four, you are well within the window for a full refund.
Oh, thank goodness. That's a huge relief. I was so confused by everything. What do I need to do now?

It's a simple process. I've just authorized the return in our system and I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just print it, place it on the original box, and drop it off at any postal service location. Once our warehouse receives the shoes, your refund will be processed back to your card.
Wow, okay. That's much easier than I thought it would be. Thank you so much for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome, Michael. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
I'm glad I could help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful rest of your day.
